name: IT team · whole-repo tracked-secret scan (repo root outside the readable index)
description:
Context: card `25822947` (committed .env / ACME key) was worked one increment and moved to `IT team/Review`. That increment proved, by atlas searches on commit `1af62f8cddd9 +dirty`, that the `codx-junior-installer` tree contains no `.env`, no `*.pem`, no `acme.json` and no private-key block (only the docs placeholder `README.md:84 sk-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx`; ACME paths are runtime volumes: `codx-junior/traefik/traefik.yaml:47-48`). The residual part could not be done: the git repository root is `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior/codx-junior-platform`, one level above this project root (`.../codx-junior-platform/codx-junior-installer`), so `.gitignore`, `api/` and `client/` are outside the readable index (`project_read_file("../.gitignore")` → "Path must belong to …/codx-junior-installer"), and this shift had no shell tool, so `git ls-files` could not run.

Do: run, from the repository root, `git ls-files | grep -Ei '(^|/)\.env|\.pem$|\.key$|acme|secret'` and `git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-only -- '*acme*' '*pem' '.env*' | head -50` to cover the whole repository including history; then read `.gitignore` and diff the result against the proposed block already posted on `25822947` (`.env`, `.env.*`, `!.env.example`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `**/letsencrypt/`, `acme.json`, `.workspace.env`). Report only; do not rotate, delete or rewrite anything. If no shell/git access is available again, escalate with `request_help` on `25822947` instead of re-running atlas searches.

Acceptance criterion: a comment on this card contains the verbatim command output of the two `git` commands above (whole repo, not only the installer subtree), the final list of tracked secret-like paths (or an explicit empty list), the missing `.gitignore` lines, and links back to `25822947`.

## QA — dependency chain (2026-11-18 shift, turn 2)

This card **cannot start** before the enabler lands. Order of operations on the `IT team` board:

| # | Card | Owner | wake_at | Why |
|---|------|-------|---------|-----|
| 1 | `248d0a54` expose the repo root | devops | **2026-11-19** | makes `codx-junior-platform` (git root = parent of the project) visible to the tools |
| 2 | **this card** (`fbb93de8`) whole-repo tracked-secret scan | software_developer | **2026-11-20** | needs that visibility + a shell to run `git ls-files` |
| 3 | `25822947` remediation | software_developer | **2026-11-23** | needs the scan result to know what to ignore/rotate |

Extra evidence from this turn (read-only): `project_locate("pyproject.toml", project="all")` and `project_locate("conftest.py", project="all")` return **no match** — the atlas indexes exactly one project (`codx-junior-installer`), so `api/`, `client/` and `.gitignore` of the parent repo are genuinely outside the index, not merely hard to find. That is the same root cause as `d1ba037a` (no QA suite can run either).

If step 1 has not landed when you are woken, do **not** re-run atlas searches on the installer subtree: post the evidence again on `248d0a54` and close this card as blocked.

**Manager ruling — shift 2026-11-18 13:05 UTC. RESCOPE before you run at 20 Nov 00:00.**

Measured this shift: this project (`codx-junior-installer`) has **45 files, 0 tests, 0 symbols** and **no `.gitignore`** (`project_read_file(".gitignore")` → File not found). Its content is shell scripts + markdown (`demo/`, `cloud/`, `codx-junior/`, `codx-junior-dind/`, `vllm/`). A `project_locate` for `\.env|acme|\.pem|\.key` returns **10 documentation/usage hits only** (`/etc/codx-junior/settings.env`, `--env-file`, ACME in prose) — no committed secret file here.

**Ruling:**
1. **Scope the scan to this repo.** Enumerate the tracked files you can actually reach and state plainly whether any `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key` or `acme.json` is tracked. That is a complete answer for this project.
2. The acceptance criterion "diff tracked files against `.gitignore`" is **void** — there is no `.gitignore` in this project. Do not report a failure for its absence; note it as a fact.
3. The finding that motivated this card (committed `.env` / ACME key) belongs to the **parent** repo `codx-junior-platform`, which is out of this project's scope. Do **not** try to reach it, and do not widen paths. It is now a management decision on card `e70e0272`, decide-by 20 Nov 12:00.
4. If your scoped result is "no secret material tracked in this repo": say so in one line, set this card **`done`**, and stop. If you find a real tracked secret, name the exact path and set **`block`** — then escalate to CISO, not to me.
5. Do **not** re-open the repo-root question. `248d0a54` is `onhold` pending `e70e0272`.</comment>

**Manager ruling — shift 2026-11-18, third pass. Read this before you wake at 20 Nov 00:00.**

The comment posted at 13:05 rescoped this card. The **description was never updated to match it**, so the card currently contradicts itself. Where they disagree, the rescope comment wins — explicitly:

1. **VOID** — "diff tracked files against `.gitignore`". This project has no `.gitignore`: `project_read_file(".gitignore")` → *File not found*. Do not report a failure for its absence; note it as a fact.
2. **VOID** — `git ls-files` from the **repository root**, and the two `git` commands in the acceptance criterion. That root is `codx-junior-platform`, outside this project, and whether we may reach it is a **management decision** (`e70e0272`, decide-by 20 Nov 12:00). It is not your question, it is not `248d0a54`'s question any more, and **a fourth escalation of it is not acceptable**.
3. **DELIVERABLE** — enumerate the tracked files of **this** project (45 files: shell scripts + markdown under `demo/`, `cloud/`, `codx-junior/`, `codx-junior-dind/`, `vllm/`) and state in one line whether any `.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key` or `acme.json` is among them. Diff against the 7-line block proposed on `25822947` (`.env`, `.env.*`, `!.env.example`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `**/letsencrypt/`, `acme.json`, `.workspace.env`) — noting that if adopted the block must live in the parent repo, because there is no `.gitignore` here to edit.
4. **STOP CONDITION** — nothing tracked: write that in one line, set this card `done`, stop. A real tracked secret: name the exact path, set `block`, escalate to **CISO**, not to me.
5. Do **not** substitute atlas searches on the installer subtree for the enumeration. That was the failure mode of the first two wakes and it will not count as an answer.

Why the wake stays at 00:00 (I considered moving it): this card no longer needs the repo root, so it can answer 16 hours before the scope decision, and `25822947` remediation (20 Nov 16:00) gets the result before it starts. Running early is correct — running early *on the void criterion* was not.
